title: Hinomori Shiho — An Autumn Breeze At Sunset〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for having us over again♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Welcome, Shih, Sakki!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but would you two mind waiting for a little bit? Miku and the others still aren't here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's okay.
Ichika and Honami also need a few more minutes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Their class is still having their end-of-day homeroom.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But they'll probably get here while we set everything up.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. Then, let's start doing that, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Sakki told me that you two are going on a trip together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we are.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, aren't you excited?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I thought you'd say, “I'm really looking forward to it,” or something!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. I'm not sure Shiho's going to give you the reaction you want.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, but it's a trip. A trip together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Not to worry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because we've come up with an itinerary that even cool and calm Shiho's gonna enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I'd love to hear more.
What's on the agenda?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: First, we're gonna check out this old Japanese-style house that's been turned into a cafe! Next, we'll get to pick grapes! And finally, we'll go leaf-viewing!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's quite a busy schedule.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Cool!
And you guys are doing all that in one day?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's the plan. We've modeled our itinerary off one we found in a magazine, so it's supposed to be fairly realistic.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup♪
Shiho did an amazing job of putting all the pieces together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait to sit by this cafe's garden, and I'm gonna have sooo many grapes! Also, I wanna have my breath taken away when I see the leaves!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Have your breath taken away? You're setting some pretty lofty expectations.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's fine! I know it's gonna be gorgeous up there!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm sure you're gonna react the same way, Shiho! I'll bet the snacks I'm taking on that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I get it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No fair, you guys...
I wanna go to that cafe, pick grapes and see the leaves. Those all sound like so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you're that interested, then why don't you come over when we go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, what she said!
We should go sightseeing together!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, but I don't wanna get in the way of you guys' trip...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We appreciate you being so polite, but you don't have to worry about us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ There's no telling when we'll get to do something like this next, so you should totally come with us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?
Hehe. Then, I think I will☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What about you guys, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, it does sound fun, but I think I'll pass...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. I'm sure Rin will enjoy herself and tell us all about what she saw.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. You know I will♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't wait for our trip! I'm so excited that I'm already having trouble sleeping.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I really am that excited♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem as energetic as ever, Saki.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: While you seem as calm and collected as ever, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Not true! I know this is all an act!
You're just as excited about this trip as I am, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You seem rather confident about that.
Do you have any proof to back up your statement?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I do! First, ever since we decided to go on this trip, I feel like she's been smiling a lot more than usual!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You feel like...?
How does that count as proof?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, she hasn't been as strict with us during practice lately!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
Just yesterday, she complimented everyone by saying, “Nice playing,” and, “Keep up the good work.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Any rebuttals?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, that's pretty simple. We played in that festival and we're in good condition right now, so it seems only natural that we'd be playing well right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, if you want me to be that strict, then I don't mind picking apart every little thing you do starting today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Yeah, I wanna get better, but I don't want you to bite my head off!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, Shiho, how do you feel about this trip?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm pretty excited...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because I was sure that Shizuku and I wouldn't be able to go on any more trips like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The same goes for me and Tsukasa.
Which is why I'm really looking forward to going♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, Shiho, we gotta have as much fun as we possibly can!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.
